dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: Oh, me? I'm chatting with the Spring Fairy.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: My name's Finch. Haha, but I'm old now, as you can see, so everyone calls me Old Finch.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell the Fairy I said hello.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: ...Of course, of course. She likes everyone around these parts.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: Way back when, she used to sneak into people's dreams to see the scenes being woven there.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: Now, she even likes poems. She often reads them to me in my dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Old Finch
dialogues.text: Hahaha, but there's so much more she still wants to learn.
